pages.title: The work
pages.text:
**Assignment list:** chapter **Strand: Sprout**.

A wheat field, a kitchen, then Mystical Agriculture. Sieve dirt for Inferium Ore and gravel for Prosperity Ore — smelt them, and the essence-seed tiers open. Botany pots if you like compact.

Finish the **Sprout Knot** and seat Sprout. Food is infrastructure. A Clowder that eats well leaves the pad sooner.

pages.title: Root
pages.text: The Rootbinders grew living anchors. When the Loom was cut, the roots held for a season. That season is why anything is still up here.
